pc_changelog:
v2.0.0 — Security Hardened Release

• SECURITY: Removed HMAC secret from public frontend JavaScript
• SECURITY: Added runtime assembly integrity check (anti-tamper)
• SECURITY: HMAC re-validation on license.json load (anti-tampering)
• SECURITY: Replay attack protection on payment API
• SECURITY: CORS restricted to trusted origins only
• SECURITY: Device limit enforced (max 3 devices per key)
• SECURITY: Removed key generation from desktop binary
• SECURITY: ConfuserEx obfuscation applied
